caption: The drawing depicts a decorative object consisting of a yellowish-green, textured spherical form at the top, which has a red, leaf-shaped element attached to the front. Surrounding the spherical form are five green leaves radiating outward, all accented with darker green details to suggest veins and shading. The object is mounted on a flared pedestal base that is primarily white but bordered with green at the bottom and trimmed with red lines. On the front of the pedestal, there is a painted floral motif with a red flower, two green leaves, and a stem, set against a yellow background framed by a red border. The entire object stands upright on a slightly rounded, green base and is set against a plain, beige background.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Mantel Ornament
